title: SF3382 (2019-2020 Regular): Firearm possession denial prohibition on the basis of medical cannabis registry enrollment

other_topics: cannabis-policy: Sections 4, 5, 7, 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, 624.714, 624.7151, 624.7152) — treats medical cannabis registry patients as not 'unlawful users' and protects their registry data; borderline, because every part is tied to firearm eligibility

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2020/0/SF/3382/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: as-filed (introduced) text; no passage vote recorded. Large file (17,407 characters); read in full. Sections 1-3 add definitions (medical cannabis, qualifying medical condition, qualifying patient). Section 6 strikes the word 'or' and a period to add clause (7). The 'multi' verdict is a judgment call: all parts concern gun rights of cannabis patients.

operative_text:
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): Participation as a patient in the medical cannabis registry under sections 152.22 to 152.37 does not disqualify the person from possessing firearms and ammunition under this section.
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 6): (f) A sheriff shall not deny an application for a permit to carry solely because the applicant is a patient enrolled in the medical cannabis registry under sections 152.22 to 152.37 and uses medical cannabis for a qualifying medical condition.
Section 6 (Minn. Stat. 624.7142, subd. 1): (7) when the person is enrolled as a patient in the medical cannabis registry under sections 152.22 to 152.37, uses medical cannabis, and knows or has reason to know that the medical cannabis used by the person has the capacity to cause impairment.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (a) A person may not be denied the right to purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm solely on the basis that the person is a qualifying patient.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (b) A state or local agency may not access a database containing the identities of qualifying patients to obtain information for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152): (d) A state or local agency may not inquire about a person's status as a qualifying patient for the purpose of approving or disapproving the person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
Section 7 (Minn. Stat. 624.7151): Any form used for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm that inquires about the applicant's use of controlled substances shall specifically authorize a qualifying patient to refrain from reporting the use of medical cannabis.
